risks.title: Asbestos Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited in Item 3 with 11,070 pending lawsuits and 126,337 since the 1980s. The language indicates an existential risk despite historically controlled costs. The Litigation category is heavily weighted here due to ongoing exposure. The risk is stable compared to the prior year.

risks.title: Third-Party Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Cited in Item 1A, FMC received notifications of breaches at third-party suppliers in 2025. Although immaterial, these incidents reveal supply chain vulnerabilities. The language reflects heightened vigilance, with annual SOC audits. The risk is implicitly increasing due to explicit mention of recent incidents.

risks.title: India Divestment
risks.score_rationale: The divestiture of the commercial business in India is announced in MD&A with an asset discount of $522 million. The language emphasizes uncertainty regarding transaction finalization and sale terms. This risk is new and material, affecting strategy and asset valuation.

risks.title: Cyber Governance and Oversight
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in Item 1A, oversight by the Audit Committee and management indicates mature governance. The risk is moderate as it is well-controlled, but repeated mention signals high priority. The language is proactive, with no signs of deterioration. The risk is stable.

risks.title: Dividend Reduction
risks.score_rationale: The dividend reduction in October 2025 is explicitly tied to financial challenges and debt reduction priorities. This reflects pressure on cash flow. The language is cautious, indicating financial deterioration. This risk is new and significant for investor confidence.
